overrides.purpose: First same-seed natural-exposure Pilot run for the minimal structured-memory research contract. The baseline model, complete state/card/legal-action context, CoT route policy, transport behavior, and environment are inherited byte-for-byte from V21. Python validates only format, evidence and memory references, identity, transactions, prompt delivery, and logs. The same deepseek-v4-flash model performs checkpoint generation and critic review. Round 1 starts from an empty store and is not a performance claim.

evidence_contract.combat: every completed combat preserves identity, outcome, every ordered action command, full model reason, engine change list, and decision-relevant structured before/after facts, joined by identity to the full trace and complete accumulated card catalog
evidence_contract.card_choice: every card decision preserves complete offered card effects, duplicate-preserving deck, relics, exact choice or skip, resulting deck, and later-use trajectory evidence
evidence_contract.route: every route decision preserves all visible choices, chosen action, complete deck, relics, card catalog, and full visible map snapshot

memory.retrieval_contract: pending_and_active_items_use_transparent_case_and_punctuation_insensitive OR matching over exact enemy names, card families, model tags, decision names, and route strings; empty keys are domain-general; no Top-K and no semantic Python gate
memory.lifecycle_contract: new_items_are_pending; actually injected Pending items are reviewed at their local combat/act checkpoint and again at run_end, Active items only at run_end; same-gate Pending merge is storage consolidation rather than efficacy evidence; all other lifecycle judgments require real exposure and are supplied by the same-model critic
memory.entity_tag_contract: enemy tags are a critic-approved replaceable classifier cache exposed in every reflection prompt; a complete replacement set or an empty set can repair or clear earlier model labels
memory.reflection_capacity_contract: lossless generator and critic prompts are preflighted against a 3000000-character provider envelope; overflow fails explicitly and never truncates evidence
